parts.stem: Order the steps needed to measure the mass of a solid object using a two-arm balance scale.

items.value: Add the numbers written on the standard masses together to give you the mass of the object.
Put standard masses on the other arm until the two arms balance.
Put the object to be measured on one of the two arms of the balance.
Put the clean balance scale horizontally on a stable surface.

correct_answer: Put the clean balance scale horizontally on a stable surface.
Put the object to be measured on one of the two arms of the balance.
Put standard masses on the other arm until the two arms balance.
Add the numbers written on the standard masses together to give you the mass of the object.
